请先填写按钮链接: Please fill in the button link first
案例链接仍可正常打开: Case links can still be opened normally
添加网站截图后，在这里预览: After adding the website screenshot, preview it here
这里将展示你的案例: Your case will be shown here
在后台添加第一个案例，即可预览。: Add the first case in the background to preview.
拖动左侧手柄调整顺序。: Drag the left handle to adjust the order.
也可以选中案例后按 Alt＋↑ / ↓。: You can also select the case and press Alt＋↑ / ↓.
拖动排序 · Alt＋方向键移动: Drag to sort · Alt + arrow keys to move
切换预览浅深色: Switch preview between light and dark colors
设置会实时更新此预览: Settings will update this preview in real time
在前台展示此案例: Display this case in the foreground
留空时显示完整案例网址。: Show full case URL when left empty.
用一句话说明截图内容，帮助读屏与图片检索。: Use one sentence to describe the content of the screenshot to help screen reading and image retrieval.
留空时使用案例网址。: Use case URL when left blank.
或填写图标链接: Or fill in the icon link
关闭上方共用开关，即可单独设置。: Turn off the shared switch above to set it individually.
支持 SVG、PNG、JPG、WebP，最大 512 KB。: Supports SVG, PNG, JPG, WebP, up to 512 KB.
模块上下留白: Leave space above and below the module
分别调整整个案例区域的上下留白，默认各10px。不改变卡片内部间距。: Adjust the upper and lower margins of the entire case area separately, defaulting to 10px each. Does not change the internal spacing of the card.
上传你自己的图标，或粘贴图片链接。设置统一应用到所有案例。: Upload your own icon, or paste a link to an image. Settings are applied uniformly to all cases.
保留图标原有颜色；上传文件和链接图片都会导入WordPress媒体库。: Keep the original color of the icon; uploaded files and linked images will be imported into the WordPress media library.
显示红黄绿圆点: Display red, yellow and green dots
恢复原版苹果式窗口细节。右上角分享与书签为装饰；放大图片使用截图上的独立入口。: Restore original Apple style window details. The sharing and bookmarks in the upper right corner are for decoration; to enlarge the picture, use the independent entrance on the screenshot.
沿用页面可用宽度，不额外缩窄。样板按本站 1440px 外层容器预览；正式接入跟: Use the available width of the page without additional narrowing. The template is previewed according to the 1440px outer container of this site; it is officially connected to follow the theme.
默认跟随网站浅深色。可在预览上方切换查看。: Default to follow website light and dark colors. You can switch between views above the preview.
图片无法显示，请换一个图标。: The image cannot be displayed, please change the icon.
图标已导入WordPress媒体库，全部案例同步更新。: The icon has been imported into the WordPress media library, and all cases are updated simultaneously.
图标已导入媒体库，保存后应用: The icon has been imported into the media library and will be applied after saving.
请填写完整的 HTTP 或 HTTPS 图片链接。: Please complete the HTTP or HTTPS image link.
电脑悬停浏览，移开后平滑回到顶部。手机轻点开始，再点回到顶部。放大按钮可打开完整: When hovering on the computer to browse, it will smoothly return to the top after moving away. Tap on your phone to start, then tap back to the top. The zoom button opens the full screenshot.
卡片轻微抬起 2px，按钮不放大。图片预览与访问网站使用独立入口，避免误跳转。: Card slightly raised 2px, button not enlarged. Use separate entrances for image preview and website access to avoid accidental jumps.
键盘可聚焦预览区，按 Enter 或空格控制。系统开启“减少动态效果”时停止自动: Keyboard can focus the preview area, press Enter or space control. When the system turns on "Reduce Dynamic Effects", automatic scrolling is stopped and screenshots can be viewed manually.
这里调整的是中央案例库的公共展示配置。保存后会更新WordPress中央案例库，: What is adjusted here is the public display configuration of the central case library. After saving, the WordPress central case library will be updated, and pages that reference these cases will use the new configuration simultaneously.
选择案例，或添加第一个案例。: Select a case, or add the first case.
添加一个案例，开始编辑图片、文字和链接。: Add a case and start editing images, text and links.
切换案例列表与设置面板: Switch case list and settings panel
创建页面 → 选择“MaoTK 案例展示”模板 → 选择案例分类: Create page → Select the "MaoTK Case Display" template → Select the case category
保存后更新所有关联页面: Update all associated pages after saving
轻点浏览长图: Tap to browse the long image
保存失败，请保留当前修改并重试。: Saving failed, please keep the current modifications and try again.
案例库已保存，关联页面已更新: The case library has been saved and the associated page has been updated
保存失败，当前修改仍保留。: Save failed, current modifications are retained.
当前案例库配置已导出: The current case library configuration has been exported
已添加案例，请填写内容: Case has been added, please fill in the content
已恢复默认外观，案例与分类保留: Default appearance restored, cases and categories retained
请选择 512 KB 以内的 SVG、PNG、JPG 或 WebP 图标。: Please select an SVG, PNG, JPG or WebP icon under 512 KB.
分类供页面选择。移除分类后，原来引用该分类的页面显示空状态，不会自动切换为全部案: Categories for page selection. After removing a category, the page that originally referenced the category will appear empty and will not automatically switch to all cases.
先在左侧“管理案例分类”中添加分类。: First add a category in the "Management Case Category" on the left.
媒体库暂时无法打开，请刷新管理页后重试。: The media library cannot be opened temporarily, please refresh the management page and try again.
已选择媒体库截图，保存后应用: Selected media library screenshot, save and apply
分类已从草稿中移除，保存后生效: Category has been removed from draft, will take effect after saving
